scope.excluded_note: A Level topics 6.1-10.4 are excluded at qualification level by the AS_ONLY route; no topic-level exclusions.

prerequisites_inherited.note: Concepts a learner must already hold before this topic is taught. Drawn from the Stage 3 dependency graph.

target_learner_profile.prior_teaching: Has been taught the full AS course. These notes consolidate and extend rather than introduce.
note_purpose: source of record for flashcard and learning-item generation
offline reading when the YYeni platform is unavailable
target_learner_profile.self_containment: Notes must stand alone. A learner reading offline cannot ask a follow-up question, so every mechanism, formula and worked example is written out in full.
target_learner_profile.context: Namibian secondary learners, Cambridge AS route, English medium.

assessment_expectations.ao4_rule: AO4 is measured in practice time, not item count. Every AO4-bearing objective carries at least one evaluation item.

depth_constraints.decision: Vitalis, 2026-09-07 - notes are the source for flashcards AND the offline study text, so they are written at teaching depth, not condensed to revision depth. Word count is not a constraint.

source_and_research_permissions.grant: Authorisation to use the sources held in this repository for the YYeni build.

sources: SRC-CIE9609-SYL-001 (the syllabus, for scope and objective wording)
derive_freely.note: Original writing carries no third-party dependency. It is the cleanest provenance available and the preferred route wherever a topic is rated generate_gap.

sources: all official_assessment sources - past papers, mark schemes, examiner reports
mine_do_not_reproduce.permitted: Analysis of assessment demand: command words, mark tariffs, AO focus, question contexts, examiner-evidenced misconceptions.
mine_do_not_reproduce.not_permitted: Reproducing question text or mark-scheme wording in learner-facing output. Mine the demand, write the answer yourself.

sources: the unattributed chapter notes and single-topic PDFs
reference_only.note: May inform and orient the author. Claims must be independently authored and verified; nothing is quoted or paraphrased closely.

outside_the_derivation_path.reason: A complete commercial publication, scanned, licence unverified. It covers little that original writing does not cover better, so excluding it costs nothing.

source_and_research_permissions.residual_note: YYeni can authorise its own use of what it holds. It cannot grant the rights of a third-party publisher. The policy above is built so that nothing in the derivation path depends on those rights: scope comes from the syllabus, demand comes from mining, and substance comes from original authoring.
source_and_research_permissions.publication_rule: Publication still requires RS-12 verification and RS-28 independent semantic review. Granting source permission unblocks authoring, not publication. Jurisdiction-sensitive claims additionally require human approval under RS-13 and RS-23.
source_and_research_permissions.external_research: Permitted against named authoritative sources, recorded as verified_external with a locator.

authoring_position.note: Provisional from Stage 3, replaced by the Stage 8 adequacy audit.

gates: RS-07 every objective maps to approved content and at least one learning item
RS-15 core notes carry only syllabus-required content; enrichment is separately labelled
RS-22 every quantitative objective has formula, units, worked calculation, interpretation and limitations
RS-31 publication blocked while any mandatory objective is uncovered or any required review is missing
